synthesis:draft.headline: VIC1 five-minute minimum RRP = -504.6525 $/MWh at 2026-07-28 21:20 AEST (UTC+1000).
summary: The minimum five-minute Regional Reference Price (RRP) observed in VIC1 was -504.6525 $/MWh at 2026-07-28 21:20 AEST (evidence: ev0442).
The low-price episode reported for 2026-07-28 covered 2026-07-28T11:15:00Z–2026-07-28T11:25:00Z (episode end local 2026-07-28 21:25 AEST) and comprised 2 five-minute intervals (evidence: ev1473).
The find_market_events analysis threshold used for detection was 0.0 $/MWh (evidence: ev1512).
Operational demand in the half-hour containing the price extreme (2026-07-28T11:30:00Z / 2026-07-28 21:30 AEST) was 7491.0 MW (evidence: ev0910).
The window maximum operational demand observed was 8131.0 MW (evidence: ev0932).
Selected five-minute price samples around the event include 2026-07-28 21:00 AEST RRP = 29.01344 $/MWh (evidence: ev0430) and 2026-07-28 22:00 AEST RRP = -45.57834 $/MWh (evidence: ev0466).
Public POE50 forecast for the half-hour ending 2026-07-28T11:30:00Z was 7276.0 MW (evidence: ev0998) while observed operational demand for that half-hour was 7491.0 MW (evidence: ev0910).

Selected unit-level SCADA changes in the 05:20–17:20 UTC window include VBB (change −137.8 MW, evidence: ev0937), CRWARPSF (change −113.61 MW, evidence: ev0940) and YENDONWF (change +106.18 MW, evidence: ev0943).
Mean unweighted five‑minute RRP across the window was 4.87 $/MWh (evidence: ev0883).

possible_explanations.statement: Rapid changes in generator outputs within the window may have contributed to negative prices (see unit-change observations ev0937, ev0940, ev0943).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare unit offer/bid submissions and dispatch target changes for those units in the five-minute intervals around 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z; check constraint-binding logs and dispatch instruction history for those intervals.

possible_explanations.statement: High renewable output relative to local demand might have played a role (see SCADA generation changes ev0943 and ev0949 and demand ev0910).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Obtain generation-by-fuel metered or SCADA time series for the five-minute intervals around 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z and compare to interconnector flows and demand (NETINTERCHANGE) in the same intervals.

possible_explanations.statement: Net interchange/export patterns could be relevant (see netinterchange at peak ev0306 and demand ev0910).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Retrieve 5-minute NETINTERCHANGE time series for VIC1 for 2026-07-28 and align to the negative-RRP intervals to see whether export flows coincided with the extreme prices.

possible_explanations.statement: AEMO operational events reported in market notices might be related to the dispatch context (refer to the notice quotation [c1]).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Examine the full market notice text and AEMO dispatch logs and any follow-up notices to see timing and operational detail; compare notice content [c1] with dispatch/SCADA timelines.
